intro: Pick the best one. Hints are here if you want them.

items.stem: Which one is a thesis on the casefile question?

options.1: American expansion between 1801 and 1850 included the Louisiana Purchase, Indian Removal, and the war with Mexico
options.2: Expansion was not worth its cost, because the nation grew by taking land from people who held treaties
options.3: There are many different opinions about whether American expansion was worth the cost it carried
options.4: Expansion was complicated and had both good results and bad results for the people who lived through it

hints: Three of these never say what the writer thinks.
Look for the one you could argue against.
items.reason: Option 1 lists the topic. Option 3 describes the debate instead of joining it. Option 4 has a position buried so deep nobody could argue with it. Only option 2 takes a side and gives a reason.

items.stem: Which one is a thesis on Jackson's government?

options.1: Jackson vetoed the Bank, signed the Indian Removal Act, and was called the champion of the common man
options.2: Jackson's government did not protect all Americans' rights, because it removed the Cherokee despite a Court ruling
options.3: Jackson's presidency was a time of big changes in American government and in who held political power
options.4: Jackson protected some people's rights and did not protect other people's rights during his two terms

hints: The question asks whether his government protected the rights of all Americans. Which one answers that?
Option 4 sounds balanced, but what side is it on?
items.reason: Option 2 answers the question that was asked, picks a side, and gives a reason you can prove with Documents 5, 6 and 7. The others name the topic or sit on the fence.

items.stem: A thesis takes a side you can prove. Which one can you prove with Casefile A?

options.1: Expansion was worth its cost, because the Erie Canal tied western farms to eastern markets (Doc 3)
options.2: Expansion was worth its cost, because most Americans at the time were happy about how it turned out
options.3: Expansion was wrong, because taking other people's land is something no country should ever do
options.4: Expansion was worth its cost, because the country would not exist in its present form without it

hints: Which one points at a document you actually have?
Ask of each one: what would I quote to prove this?
items.reason: Option 1 rests on Document 3, which is in your hands. Option 2 claims to know what most Americans felt and no document says it. Option 3 is a belief, not a historical claim. Option 4 cannot be proved or disproved by anything.
